A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before yourmoment.

How do I book an appointment?+

Choose your ritual below and call the house. For hair, color and balayage, call 50 677 903. For nails, call 20 082 569. Your appointment is confirmed directly with the team.

Where can I find THE REFLECT?+

Our private beauty house is in La Soukra, Tunis. Contact the team for the precise location and directions before your visit.

Can I visit without an appointment?+

THE REFLECT welcomes women by appointment only. Please get in touch before visiting so we can make time for your ritual.

I'm not sure which service to choose.+

Start with a conversation. Tell the team what you have in mind and share your inspiration. They can discuss your hair or nail needs, the service, timing and price before you book.
